sourceFile: 29. MSU-L20S15-07 LIST TEST IMPROVE NG FUNCTION SPK 20225.03.05_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges many independent SPK improvement tests into one incorrect comparison case.
issues: Many numbered experiments are collapsed into one changed factor.
Change domain is wrongly labeled as supplier.
Baseline and test rows are mismatched across unrelated items.
NG metrics are misread from Sigma/SPL columns instead of total NG rates.
Evidence includes header/formula rows and omits many valid groups.
requiredUserQuestions: Should each numbered test item be reviewed as a separate case/context?
correctionPlan: Split or regroup by No., item family, date, requester, and normal baseline.
Define each primary changed factor from the item text within its group.
Use matching Normal rows only within the same comparable group.
Recalculate outcomes using Total NG and NG rate columns for Sigma and Hearing domains.
Remove header/formula-only evidence rows and cite only condition/result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient because grouping and metric interpretation are invalid.
